steps.text: add-1/8 cup shredded mozzarella to a bowl
visible_evidence: hand pouring shredded mozzarella from measuring cup into bowl
shredded white cheese visible inside the bowl

checks.text: Shredded mozzarella is placed inside the mixing bowl

steps.text: add-1/4 tsp salt to a bowl
visible_evidence: measuring spoon holding salt tilted over bowl
salt sprinkled onto ingredients in the bowl

checks.text: Salt is added into the mixing bowl

steps.text: add-1/4 tsp pepper to a bowl
visible_evidence: measuring spoon holding pepper tilted over bowl
dark pepper flecks visible in the bowl

checks.text: Pepper is added into the mixing bowl

steps.text: Slice-Slice two 1/2 inch thick rounds from a baguette (slice slanted)
visible_evidence: serrated knife slicing baguette at an angle on cutting board
two slanted baguette rounds resting on cutting board

checks.text: The knife cuts through the baguette at a diagonal slant
The sliced baguette rounds are roughly 1/2 inch thick

steps.text: Brush-Brush 2 slices of baguette with olive oil on both sides
visible_evidence: pastry brush spreading olive oil across bread surface
baguette slices flipped and brushed on the opposite side
glossy oil sheen visible on both sides of the slices

checks.text: Both sides of each baguette slice are coated with olive oil using a brush

steps.text: Toast-Toast both sides of the slices on the pan for 2 to 3 minutes until lightly charred and crispy and transfer the slices to a plate
visible_evidence: oiled baguette slices placed flat on heated pan
slices flipped in the pan showing lightly charred brown marks
toasted baguette slices resting on a plate

checks.text: Both sides of the baguette slices are toasted in the pan until lightly charred
The slices cook on the pan for 2 to 3 minutes
The toasted slices are transferred from the pan onto a plate

steps.text: Cut-Cut 1/4 cup of cherry tomatoes into halves
visible_evidence: knife slicing cherry tomatoes on cutting board
halved cherry tomatoes with cut sides exposed on board

checks.text: Each cherry tomato is sliced cleanly into two halves

steps.text: add-1/16 cup basil to a bowl
visible_evidence: hand adding green basil leaves from measuring cup into bowl
basil pieces visible inside the bowl

checks.text: Basil is placed inside the mixing bowl

steps.text: add-In a bowl, add the cut cherry tomatoes
visible_evidence: hand scooping halved cherry tomatoes from cutting board into bowl
halved cherry tomatoes visible inside the bowl

checks.text: The halved cherry tomatoes are transferred into the mixing bowl

steps.text: Combine-Combine the contents of the bowl
visible_evidence: spoon stirring ingredients inside the bowl
tomatoes, mozzarella, basil, and seasonings evenly distributed together

checks.text: The tomatoes, mozzarella, basil, salt, and pepper are evenly mixed together in the bowl

steps.text: Spoon-Spoon the mixture from the bowl onto the bread
visible_evidence: spoon lifting tomato mozzarella mixture from bowl
mixture piled on top of toasted baguette slices on the plate

checks.text: A spoon scoops the tomato and mozzarella mixture from the bowl onto the toasted baguette slices
